title: Comments on row 6 (Grade R Seahorses) in '2027 Staff & Class Allocations - DRAFT v3'
where: Shared Google Doc, Little Proteas Pre-Primary staff drive

messages.author: Deirdre Fortuin
messages.body: Staff, this is v3 of the allocations for next year. Please go through your own row and comment by Thursday so I can take it to SMT on Friday 13 Nov. Main change from v2: with Grade 00 going up to 24 kids, Noma Mkhize moves across to Bronwyn's class full time and the Seahorses get Charlene Adams (new appointment, starts 11 Jan). I know nobody loves moving people around, but the numbers are the numbers.

messages.author: Bronwyn Hendricks
messages.body: Thanks Deirdre. Happy with mine obviously, 24 little ones on my own was not going to work lol. Sorry Kayla, I promise I'll look after her!!

messages.author: Deirdre Fortuin
messages.body: @Kayla Jacobs I know this one lands hardest on you. You and Noma have built something really good in that room. If you have concerns, or anything you'd like me to put to SMT about the handover, write it here by Thursday please. Nothing is final until Friday.
